categories.main_business_segments: Ringpu Bio primarily operates in the veterinary pharmaceutical industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of veterinary biological products, chemical drug formulations, raw materials, and functional additives. The company serves both economic animals (such as pigs, poultry, cattle, sheep) and companion animals (pets), offering a comprehensive range of vaccines, medicines, disinfectants, and health products. It also operates a pet supply chain segment, including pet pharmaceuticals and medical supplies distribution.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced biotechnologies including reverse genetics, protein expression, gene editing, mRNA vaccine platforms, and synthetic biology. It employs large-scale cell suspension culture, high-density bacterial fermentation, and antigen purification technologies. Production adheres to strict GMP standards with integrated quality control systems ensuring traceability and high product purity. The R&D model combines independent innovation with collaborative open research, supported by AI drug discovery and integrated product development processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ringpu Bio's primary customers include large-scale livestock farming enterprises, small and medium-sized farms, veterinary hospitals, and pet owners. It targets economic animal sectors such as pig, poultry, cattle, sheep, and aquatic farming, as well as the rapidly growing companion animal market in China. The company also participates in government procurement for mandatory immunization programs and exports products to international markets including Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with key regional markets in East China, North China, South China, Central China, Southwest China, Northeast China, and Northwest China. It has expanded its international footprint with product registrations and GMP certifications in countries like Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Thailand, and Taiwan. Its headquarters and major production bases are located in Tianjin Free Trade Zone and other strategic locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ringpu Bio operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the veterinary pharmaceutical supply chain. It develops and manufactures veterinary vaccines, drugs, and additives, and distributes these products through direct sales, dealer networks, and government tenders. The company also controls upstream raw material production through subsidiaries and strategic acquisitions, integrating supply chain management to optimize procurement and production efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation with a focus on gene-engineered vaccines, mRNA vaccines, synthetic biology, and AI-driven drug discovery. It aims to build an open innovation platform integrating research, production, and sales, and to develop a diversified product portfolio addressing major animal diseases. Strategic priorities include expanding the companion animal health segment, international market penetration, and digital transformation of operations and marketing.
categories.revenue_model: Ringpu Bio generates revenue primarily through the sale of veterinary biological products, chemical drug formulations, raw materials, and functional additives. Sales channels include direct sales to large-scale farms, distribution through dealers, government procurement tenders, and pet supply chain sales. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ringpu Bio is one of the largest and most comprehensive veterinary pharmaceutical companies in China, recognized as a leading domestic brand with a broad product portfolio. It competes with numerous domestic and international veterinary drug manufacturers, particularly in biological products and pet pharmaceuticals. The company holds a strong market position due to its technological capabilities, extensive product approvals, and strategic partnerships with major livestock groups and pet hospitals.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Ringpu Bio reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.07 billion, representing a 13.32% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 300.7 million, a decline of 33.7% compared to the previous year. The company maintains substantial assets totaling nearly RMB 8 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for 7.76% of revenue. It has a diversified income base and is expanding through acquisitions and international market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ringpu Bio offers comprehensive, high-quality veterinary health solutions covering the full lifecycle of economic and companion animals. Its competitive advantages include advanced biotechnology platforms, a broad and differentiated product portfolio with over 500 approved products, and integrated services combining vaccines, diagnostics, and health management. The company emphasizes product safety, efficacy, and innovation, supported by strong customer service and a robust supply chain, enabling it to meet diverse customer needs and drive import substitution in pet pharmaceuticals.
